'''Water Blast''' is a [[Water spells|water]]-based [[Blast spells|blast spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 47 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest water spell available to [[free-to-play]] players.

==Damage==
Water Blast's base maximum hit starts at 14 and increases as the player unlocks additional blast spells, up to 16 at level 59 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Water Blast's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a water-based spell, Water Blast's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to water]].

== Notable uses ==

* During the [[Family Crest]] quest, the player must deal damage to the demon [[Chronozon]] with Water Blast (along with each of the other three blast spells) at least once in order to defeat it.
